cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Wonderful promotion. Your timing with the director's retirement was beautiful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And how considerate of the vacancy to arrive when you were ready.

mechanism: A supervises promotion congratulations as though B needs professional guidance, letting rivalry color every supportive remark.
confusable: D201 requests A's contribution credit; D213 keeps the surface on B's success while resentment leaks.
comparison: Workplace handover and promotion differ from craft judging.
seedUse: Keep work-versus-timing defense; make B offer a real professional task that A can turn into resentful praise.
